bio: Set in ancient stables, with a refreshing terrace overlooking a garden prepared for outdoor service in the summertime, Il Patio is a popular gourmet destination in the area. Its success is due to high-quality gastronomy and excellent, highly professional service. Led by chef-owner Sergio Vineis, alongside his son Simone, the cuisine begins with a connection to the local area and evolves into a balanced contemporary style. The wine selection is extensive, well-structured, and always distinctive....
